violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed mixing cups for coffee and tea drinks being rinsed in between uses and the PIC stated they are sanitized every 6 hours, not every 4 hours, as required.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. All equipment and utensils must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized before use, after use, or at least every 4 hours. The EHS discussed the 4-hour sanitize requirement with the PIC who said she would implement it.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: The wiping cloth quaternary ammonia sanitizing solution behind the service counter was too low at less then 100 ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Chemical sanitization (manual or mechanical operations) including the application of sanitizing chemicals by immersion, manual swabbing, brushing, or pressure spraying methods using a solution by providing: 1) an exposure time of at least 10 seconds for a chlorine solution, 2) an exposure time of at least 7 seconds for a chlorine solution of 50mg/L that has a pH of 10 or less and a water temperature of 100F or a pH of 8 or less and a water temperature of 75F, 3) an exposure time of at least 30 seconds for other chemical sanitizing solutions, or 4) an exposure time used in relationship with a combination of temperature, concentration, and pH that when evaluated for efficacy yields sanitization. The PIC corrected the concentration during the inspection.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: Observed the three drain pipes under the three compartment sink had air breaks. The wash and rinse basins are permitted to have air breaks, but the sanitizer basin must have an air gap of at least 1 inch.
violations.corrective_action: Provide an air gap of at least 1” on the sanitizer basin of the three compartment sink. This requires a three day correction. Correct within 3 days or by Monday, July 20.
